page.text:
The axioms introduced thus far cannot prove the existence of any infinite
set. The Axiom of Infinity bridges the chasm between the finite and the
transfinite by postulating a set $I$ containing the empty set $\emptyset$
and closed under the von Neumann successor operation
$S(Y) = Y \cup \{Y\}$. This inductive structure provides the foundational
representation of the natural numbers $\mathbb{N}$.
